stage0079_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$トウジ$$ and $$ケンスケ$$ came
　to $$第３新東京市$$ too, huh?」

stage0079_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「We came to see $$トウジ$$'s sister.
　Then, out of nowhere, we got told
　to evacuate, and $c showed up - what a scramble.」

stage0079_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$正太郎$$
「You seem to be enjoying this, $$ケンスケ$$.」

stage0079_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Well, yeah.
　Getting to film an EVA's supersonic dash
　was insanely lucky.」

stage0079_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It was pretty rough on our end, though.」

stage0079_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$トウジ$$
「For that, you sure seem in a good mood.」

stage0079_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Well, call it a reward for your hard work.
　Here, ice cream's on me.」

stage0079_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「That last mission was so tough,
　this ice cream tastes even better than usual.」

stage0079_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It's rare for $$トウジ$$ to treat us.」

stage0079_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$トウジ$$
「If you've got complaints, you don't have to eat it.」

stage0079_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Just say you're happy your sister's
　doing better, honestly for once.」

stage0079_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Shut it!
　You didn't need to say that, idiot!」

stage0079_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Hey, Ikari...
　Unit-03... it's coming to Japan?」

stage0079_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Unit-03, as in an EVA?
　I haven't heard anything...」

stage0079_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Apparently they're running the activation
　test here in Japan. Know who's piloting it?」

stage0079_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't know.
　This is the first I've even heard
　Unit-03 was coming.」

stage0079_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Lucky, the pilot!
　Wish they'd pick me～!」

stage0079_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Keep yapping and your ice cream'll melt.」

stage0079_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Aw, darn...
　My ice pop stick came up empty.」

stage0079_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Me too.
　...How about you, $$トウジ$$?」

stage0079_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Hm... mine came up empty too.」

stage0079_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$シンジ$$, you're heading to
　NERV HQ after this, right?」

stage0079_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$トウジ$$ and the others are gonna
　show us around $$第３新東京市$$.」

stage0079_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Playing tour guide for grade-schoolers...
　pathetic, even for me. If it was Boss
　$$ゼシカ$$ or Boss $$ＭＩＸ$$, I'd feel a thrill...」

stage0079_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「No need to humor $$トウジ$$'s jokes.
　Let's go, $$正太郎$$, $$ワッ太$$.」

stage0079_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$トウジ$$
「See ya, $$シンジ$$.
　Catch you at school.」

stage0079_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I have to do my best...
　for $$トウジ$$ and $$ケンスケ$$'s sake too...）

stage0079_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$マリ$$
「Oop, sorry sorry!
　But you're also at fault for standing
　around in the road, y'know.」

stage0079_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$マリ$$
「Let's call it even and forgive each other!」

stage0079_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...I think walking while on the phone
　is the problem, though...」

stage0079_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「How did she know I'm with NERV...」

stage0079_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Work's almost done.
　Let's eat soon.」

stage0079_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Is it nice to eat with someone?」

stage0079_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Commander Ikari.
　How about a meal with Ikari
　and everyone, sometime?」

stage0079_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「No... I don't have the time for that...」

stage0079_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$レイ#333$$
（Ikari taught me 'thank you'...
　words of gratitude... my first words...）

stage0079_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$アスカ$$
（Hmm, for Stupid $$シンジ$$,
　maybe a lighter seasoning's better...）

stage0079_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$アスカ$$
（Compared to $$甲児$$,
　his cooking's seasoning is simpler...）

stage0079_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$アスカ$$
（There's no way I can lose...
　Sounds like Teacher's Pet got recipes
　from $$アルト$$ and $$甲児$$...）

stage0079_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Working hard, I see, $$アスカ$$～」

stage0079_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アスカ$$
「W-what...?
　Is it that weird for me to cook?」

stage0079_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$アスカ$$
「It just bugs me letting Stupid $$シンジ$$
　act so smug forever just because
　he can cook a little...」

stage0079_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「First $$レイ#333$$, now $$アスカ$$ too -
　suddenly getting all girly.」

stage0079_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What! Don't lump me in with
　Teacher's Pet...!」

stage0079_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Hmm, well.
　Seems like $$レイ#333$$'s got an even
　bigger plan going on...」

stage0079_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Seems like she wants to play cupid
　and bring Commander Ikari and
　$$シンジ$$-chan closer together.」

stage0079_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「The plan's homemade food and a dinner
　with everyone, apparently.
　Simple, but it'll work.」

stage0079_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Here, this is... your invitation, $$アスカ$$.」

stage0079_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Honestly, getting that father and son
　to get along is such a chore.」

stage0079_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アスカ$$
「That woman... for Stupid $$シンジ$$'s sake?」

stage0079_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「It's a surprise, so don't you
　go spoiling it to $$シンジ$$-chan.」

stage0079_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$アスカ$$
「As if I'd tell him, of all people!」

stage0079_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Keep practicing your cooking, $$アスカ$$.
　I'm off to HQ again.」

stage0079_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Teacher's Pet is at HQ too, huh...
　Then I'm coming along.」

stage0079_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Then let's get some bandages
　on those cut-up fingers first.」

stage0079_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「How are things looking in Dakar?」

stage0079_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$シモン$$
「Seems the Federation Forces intend
　to just watch and wait.」

stage0079_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$キタン$$
「Why the hell not?
　If they know Neo Zeon's coming,
　they should just meet 'em with a big force!」

stage0079_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$隼人$$
「Right now in Dakar, the moderates,
　led by the Earth Federation $$大統領$$,
　are apparently holding some meeting.」

stage0079_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$隼人$$
「That's exactly what's happening.
　EFF Supreme Command, run by Chrono now,
　means to let the $$大統領$$ and the others die.」

stage0079_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Damn it!
　We pushed ourselves too hard last mission,
　and now we still can't move...」

stage0079_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$隼人$$
「A military faction against Supreme
　Command, and $$プリベンター$$, have spared
　some troops. It's them and Londo Bell now.」

stage0079_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Yes.
　I've been trying various things.」

stage0079_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$n
「Looking at those bandage-covered fingers,
　I can tell you're working hard.」

stage0079_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$甲児$$
「Heard about it from $$ミサト$$.
　Once that dinner's done, let us
　have a taste too, yeah?」

stage0079_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Ayanami... what's she talking
　about with $n and the others?）

stage0079_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Ayanami... does she like older people...）

stage0079_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$加持$$
「She's changing.
　Even Katsuragi and Ricchan admit it」

stage0079_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...I think that's a good thing」

stage0079_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$加持$$
「But you're left out of it, and it's a bit
　lonely... something like that?」

stage0079_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$加持$$
「You've got time today, right?
　How about a date with me for once?」

stage0079_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$アスカ$$
「So this is where you were」

stage0079_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Is EVA really that important to you?」

stage0079_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Isn't that true of you too?」

stage0079_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「...EVA is a mirror of one's own heart」

stage0079_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「You don't need to rely on EVA.
　You have a happiness that doesn't need it」

stage0079_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Don't act so high-and-mighty!
　You're just the Teacher's Pet!」

stage0079_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$アスカ$$
「It's because I'm a genius that
　I was chosen as a pilot on my own merit.
　I'm not like you lot who got in through connections!」

stage0079_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「I'm only ever connected.
　It's only through EVA that I can connect with anyone」

stage0079_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Shut up!
　You're just his prim little doll who does
　whatever Commander Ikari says, that's all!?」

stage0079_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「You are a doll!
　Know yourself for once!」

stage0079_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$アスカ$$
「...Those fingers... you've been
　working hard at cooking, huh...」

stage0079_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Hmph... pretty mouthy for a doll」

stage0079_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I'll ask you one thing.
　What do you think of that idiot?」

stage0079_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$アスカ$$
「When I say idiot, I mean Idiot $$シンジ$$.
　...Though there's no shortage of idiots...」

stage0079_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$アスカ$$
「This is why dolls are...!
　Just spit it out already!」

stage0079_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「I don't know... But I feel warm inside
　whenever I'm with Ikari. I want him to feel it too」

stage0079_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「I think... I want him to get closer to
　Commander Ikari and feel that warmth too」

stage0079_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Seriously!
　You're such an ultra-idiot!
　That just means you like him, doesn't it?!」

stage0079_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...Did you make sure to give $$シンジ$$-chan
　$$レイ#333$$'s invitation?」

stage0079_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$加持$$
「As you asked, I kept it a secret that
　Commander Ikari would be attending too」

stage0079_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$加持$$
「But he's adorable, isn't he.
　When he found out about the dinner,
　he gave me the biggest smile」

stage0079_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Even so, what's the deal with pushing him
　down in public and demanding a kiss?」

stage0079_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$サザンカ$$ was thoughtful enough to send me
　a photo of you two kissing, with Corporal $$ミーナ#120$$'s
　fantasy novel attached!」

stage0079_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$加持$$
「It was a joke.
　I never actually stole a kiss」

stage0079_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$加持$$
「Come on, drink up.
　I brought some interesting news today」

stage0079_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$加持$$
「That'll sober you up, I bet」

stage0079_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$加持$$
「I doubt it'll live up to your expectations,
　but narrowing down the membership is coming along」

stage0079_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$加持$$
「Seems Chrono's members are
　basically hereditary, from what I can tell」

stage0079_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Hereditary...?
　Does it have that long a history?」

stage0079_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$加持$$
「Apparently, the fact NERV could be reborn
　in this world was partly their doing too」

stage0079_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Then Commander Ikari, and that group
　rumored to be above us, $$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$...
　they're in contact with Chrono...」

stage0079_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Is Chrono the one rushing Unit-03's
　activation experiment too...?」

stage0079_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$加持$$
「I don't know that much.
　It's not clear how much they know
　about EVA and the Angels either」

stage0079_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$加持$$
「I'll keep investigating the Human Instrumentality
　Project too, said to be NERV's true purpose」

stage0079_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ミサト$$
「What are Commander Ikari and the others
　up to behind the scenes...」

stage0079_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$加持$$
「That's enough of this talk.
　Let's enjoy some grown-up time now」

stage0079_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I'm not in the mood for that...」

stage0079_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$加持$$
「Have you decided on Unit-03's test pilot?」

stage0079_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...Today's meeting officially set the schedule.
　And of all days, it's the same day as that dinner...」

stage0079_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$アスカ$$ found out and volunteered」

stage0079_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$加持$$
「She's got a good side to her, that girl...」

stage0079_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ミサト$$
「It caught me off guard too」

stage0079_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$-chan, $$レイ#333$$, and $$アスカ$$ are all changing...
　Even carrying such a heavy burden, they're not letting it beat them...」

stage0079_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$加持$$
「...It's too heavy a burden for kids.
　But we have no choice but to rely on them」

stage0079_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$アスカ$$
（It's almost time for things to start over there too...）

stage0079_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$アスカ$$
（I hope Teacher's Pet's crazy cooking
　makes Idiot $$シンジ$$ and Commander Ikari both keel over）

stage0079_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What is it, $$ミサト$$?
　The experiment's about to start...」

stage0079_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$レイ#333$$'s on the phone for you」

stage0079_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Seriously...
　You called because you had something to say,
　right? So what's with all this silence?」

stage0079_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Well, I'll get going then.
　Sorry, right before the experiment」

stage0079_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Don't look at me... just listen」

stage0079_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Let me go first.
　I want to properly thank you for today.
　Thank you」

stage0079_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「No need to thank me.
　Helping the masses is just an elite's duty」

stage0079_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I was never good at eating with everyone anyway,
　and pretending to have fun to match others is tiring,
　and I hated watching other people be happy...」

stage0079_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$アスカ$$
「As long as I got to pilot EVA, that was enough,
　and I've always liked being alone anyway,
　I never needed clingy friends...」

stage0079_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$アスカ$$
「There was never anyone who really saw me anyway,
　and as long as I keep top scores,
　I can get by on my own at NERV」

stage0079_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$アスカ$$
「...But lately, I've started thinking
　it's nice being around others sometimes.
　Doesn't suit me, though...」

stage0079_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's not true.
　You're kind, $$アスカ$$...」

stage0079_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$アスカ$$
「You're the first person I've told this to, $$ミサト$$.
　...Somehow, I feel lighter」

stage0079_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Talking to someone feels nice.
　I never knew」

stage0079_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「This world's full of interesting things
　you don't know about yet.
　Go enjoy them」

stage0079_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Yeah, that's true...
　Thanks, $$ミサト$$」

stage0079_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ミサト$$
「It's about time to change into your test plug suit.
　I'm counting on you, $$アスカ$$」

stage0079_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Leave it to me, there's nothing to worry about」

stage0079_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I see...
　I... I can laugh...」

stage0079_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$冬月$$
「What's the damage status at Matsushiro?」

stage0079_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$シゲル$$
「Unknown.
　The temporary cage seems to be the epicenter.
　Collapse of the surface facility confirmed」

stage0079_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$シゲル$$
「No contact from Colonel Katsuragi
　or Dr. Akagi on site either」

stage0079_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$冬月$$
「Dispatch rescue and the 3rd Unit at once.
　Handle it all before the Federation forces step in」

stage0079_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$マコト$$
「Unidentified moving object detected
　southwest of the accident site.
　Pattern Orange! Cannot confirm it as an Angel!」

stage0079_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$マコト$$
「Unit-00 and $c are still under maintenance...!
　Unit-01 is the only one that can launch right now!」

stage0079_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Unit-01 will launch immediately after being
　fitted with the dummy plug」

stage0079_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$マコト$$
「You're going to use the dummy system!?」

stage0079_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Since Colonel Katsuragi's whereabouts are
　also unknown, I will take direct command」

stage0079_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$加持$$
「You can't get up yet, Katsuragi.
　Don't push yourself」

stage0079_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$加持$$
「No need to worry.
　Lighter injuries than yours」

stage0079_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...$$アスカ$$ is...!
　EVA Unit-03 is...!?」

stage0079_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$加持$$
「...I hear it was processed... as an Angel.
　By Unit-01...」

stage0079_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Master $$シンジ$$...
　You mustered your courage and defeated an Angel
